steps.title: Inspect Current App State
steps.description: Reviewing the existing codebase of Native Image Text Replacer to identify text editing bottlenecks.

steps.title: Analyze OCR Text Editing Flow
steps.description: Pinpoint the user flow issue where selected text boxes default to empty instead of pre-populating with their original text, which prevents intuitive editing.

steps.title: Update MainActivity to Pre-populate Original Text
steps.description: Modify the 'onBlockSelected' listener in MainActivity.java to set the replacement text field to the block's original text if no replacement exists yet, enabling seamless inline editing.

steps.title: Validate Style Retention Mechanisms
steps.description: Verify that analyzeStyle in EditorView.java continues to extract the precise background color, text color, and size during edits.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Double-check that all changes in MainActivity.java adhere strictly to Java 8 specifications without using lambdas or stream APIs.

steps.title: Review EditorView Draw Layering
steps.description: Verify that the text replacements are rendered cleanly above the background brush layer but below overlays.

steps.title: Review Saving Functionality
steps.description: Confirm that the composite bitmap successfully incorporates the edited text blocks with original styles and saves it correctly to disk.

steps.title: Verify Resource Mappings
steps.description: Ensure that all buttons and UI controls in the layout files continue to bind correctly.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Configurations
steps.description: Confirm package definitions and launcher intent declarations match target parameters.

steps.title: Building Native Image Text Replacer
steps.description: Finalizing compilation of the app with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.
